<!doctype html>

<head>

<title>Richardson Built | Full-Service Automotive, Gas &amp; Diesel in Kimberly, Idaho</title>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:ital,wght@1,600;1,800&family=Barlow:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#111214;--panel:#1A1C1F;--line:#2E3136;--text:#E8EAED;--muted:#B8BDC4;--red:#E5312B;--red-ink:#FF5A52;color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#111214}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:18px;line-height:1.55}
.disp{font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',Impact,sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;line-height:1}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:88vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;background:#0c0d0e url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) 30% 70%/cover no-repeat;border-top:12px solid var(--red)}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(17,18,20,.92) 0,rgba(17,18,20,.55) 30%,rgba(17,18,20,.15) 55%,rgba(17,18,20,.85) 88%,var(--bg) 100%)}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;padding-top:48px;padding-bottom:56px;width:100%}
.logo{width:min(260px,52vw);height:auto;display:block;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(56px,11vw,128px)}
h1 span{color:var(--red)}
.tag{font-size:clamp(22px,3.4vw,34px);margin:14px 0 6px;color:var(--text)}
.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 26px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 26px;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:800;font-size:26px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border:3px solid var(--red);color:#fff;background:var(--red);min-height:48px}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--text)}
.btn:hover,.btn:focus-visible{background:#fff;border-color:#fff;color:#111214;outline:none}
section{padding:72px 0}
h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:clamp(40px,6vw,64px)}
h2 span{color:var(--red)}
.lead{color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch;margin:0 0 36px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:18px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:5px solid var(--red);padding:24px}
.card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:32px;line-height:1.05}
.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.band{background:var(--red);color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:30px 24px}
.band p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,52px)}
.visit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:36px;align-items:start}
.info p{margin:0 0 18px}
.info b{display:block;color:var(--red-ink);font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:20px}
.info a{color:var(--text);text-decoration-color:var(--red)}
.phone{font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,64px);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none}
.phone:hover{color:var(--red-ink)}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:28px 0 36px;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
</style>
</head>
